title: Fiat system assemble karo
instruction: Har card uske system-slot mein lagao. Sab parts milkar batayenge ki gold backing ke bina fiat ki value kaise chalti hai.

pieces.label: Paper ya digital numbers
pieces.right: Fiat ka monetary value paper ya digital form ki intrinsic value se nahi aata.
pieces.wrong: Material ko authority ya backing banaane se paper ki keemat aur money ki value ek samajh loge.

pieces.label: Gold/silver se value tied nahi
pieces.right: Fiat commodities se backed nahi; gold redemption iska value-base nahi hai.
pieces.wrong: Yeh card commodity link hataata hai, public trust ya issuing authority nahi.

pieces.label: Govt-issued; central bank control
pieces.right: Government authority fiat ka base hai; book production control central banks se jodti hai.
pieces.wrong: Issuer ko material ya gold reserve slot mein rakhne se authority ka role gayab ho jaata hai.

pieces.label: Public ka government par trust
pieces.right: Public faith value ko support karta hai. Sirf paper hona fiat ki poori explanation nahi.
pieces.wrong: Trust physical backing ya printing action nahi; yeh public faith wala base hai.

pieces.label: Need par aur money issue ho sakta hai
pieces.right: Book ke mutabik governments need par aur print kar sakti hain; gold-backed system jaisa redemption constraint nahi.
pieces.wrong: Printing capacity ko value ka akela source banaane se authority aur trust chhoot jaayenge.

win: Fiat assemble hua: material ki value nahi, government authority aur public trust central hain.
